## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 1. 标准分区过滤 + 取最新分区 (最常用, ~100% 查询)
WHERE grass_date in (
    SELECT max(grass_date) AS grass_date
    FROM mp_foa.dim_search_domain_map__reg_live
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
)
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

## Common Aggregations

## Representative SQL Snippets

```sql
-- Snippet 1: page_mapping 维度视图 (全部 18 个 region 文件中的标准模式)
-- 将 search scenario_key 映射为 page_type，用于 traffic 的 entry_point 分类
create or replace temporary view page_mapping as
select scenario_key
    , mapped_page_type
from mp_foa.dim_search_domain_map__reg_live
where grass_date in (
    select max(grass_date) as grass_date
    from mp_foa.dim_search_domain_map__reg_live
    where grass_region = upper('${region}')
)
  and grass_region = upper('${region}')
group by 1, 2
;
```
